mentions.name: Tab Highway
mentions.description: A browser extension that turns tab cleanup into a game: when open tabs pile up (or on demand), it opens a night drive where each tab is a road sign the user drives through or sends to the trash. Still a work in progress and not fully distribution-ready.
mentions.problem: Users pile up too many open tabs and need a way to declutter them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
## Tab Highway: Browser extension focusing on the UX/process of decluttering

It turns tab cleanup into a game.

When you pile up too many open tabs or whenever you want, it opens a night drive where each tab is a road sign you drive through or send to the trash.
